title: Build Your Own CRM with AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Fees
summary: How to build a custom CRM with AI that replaces Salesforce's core features. Real cost comparison, honest tradeoffs, and a 60-minute build guide using Blink.
body_markdown: Most common integrations — Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, webhooks — can be added to a Blink CRM with one conversation. More complex integrations (Salesforce's native LinkedIn Sales Navigator deep-link, for example) require building. The honest answer: if you need 5+ complex integrations that already exist in AppExchange, Salesforce may be the right call. If you use 1–2 integrations, build them.
